Webinar on the Occasion of Ozone Day-2026 organized by the Department of Botany
Department of Botany, Nanda Nath Saikia College, Titabor (Assam) organized a webinar on the occasion of World Ozone Day on google meet (Online platform) to create an awareness among students and participants about the importance of the ozone layer and the need for its protection on 16-09-2026, at 6:00 PM. The theme of the webinar was “Cooler planet, Brighter future”.The webinar commenced with an introductory speech by Dr. Songita Sonowal, Guest Faculty, Department of Botany, N. N. Saikia College, who welcomed all the distinguished guest, invited resource person, faculty members, and students. In the introductory speech the significance of world ozone day celebration and why it is important to protect the ozone layer for a healthy life was highlighted. After concluding the introductory speech, the floor was handed over to Dr. Pranab Bhattacharya, Head of the department of Botany to inaugurate the session by giving a speech. The inaugural speech was focused on the ozone layer and their importance on human beings. After completion of inaugural speech Dr. Songita Sonowal requested to Dr. Suvangshu Dutta, Principal, N. N. Saikia College, Titabor, for giving a welcome speech.
The resource person, Dr. Nabanita Bhattacharyya, Associate professor, Department of Botany, Gauhati University, Guwahati delivered an informative lecture on the topic “Healthy ozone layer for a safer tomorrow”. In the presentation the speaker discussed about importance of ozone layer and how depletion of ozone layer affecting the plants and animals on earth. The speaker mentioned how humans are responsible for the depletion of ozone layer and what are the potent greenhouse gases that affecting the ozone layer. Impact of ozone depletion in climate change and different types of greenhouse gases and there positive and negative impact on ozone layer and climate change was also discussed. The speaker also highlighted the importance of international efforts, particularly the Montreal Protocol and Kigali amendment in addressing ozone-depleting substances. Some snapshot taken during presentation are attached here. The students and faculty members are actively participated on the webinar. The webinar provides an opportunity to participants to understand the relationship between ozone-layer protection, climate change, and environmental conservation. The interactive session that followed by the lecture was open for all the participants to clarify their queries and share their thoughts with the resource person. All the students were participated actively in the interactive session. The snapshot of interactive session is attached here. At last, a vote of thanks delivered by Dr. Songita Sonowal on behalf of the department of Botany to expressed a heartfelt gratitude to the resource person, principal, faculty members, and students for their valuable participation and contribution to the successful organization of the webinar on World Ozone Day-2026. The programme ended with a closing remark by Dr. Pranaba Nanad Bhattacharyya.
